text:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: High error rate detected for /v1/generate in eu-west-1 — 5xx spike to 32% over 5m, latency p95 up 3x

jordan (oncall): Saw the page. I'm on it. Checking dashboards and recent deploys.

sam (sre): Not seeing any recent deploys in that region. CPU on GPU fleets is normal but redis latency to prefix-cache is elevated. Suspect an upstream network flake.

lee (cloud-eng): We're getting similar alerts on the cloud provider side for eu-west-1 networking fabric — internal note: networking-evt-9342. Opening a support escalation now.

devops-bot: Created incident INC-1998002468 and routed to oncall. Pager duty handled by jordan.

jordan (oncall): Quick triage: route health shows increased 502 from model-proxy -> runtime. Can anyone confirm whether runtime instances are returning 500 or proxy is translating?

sam (sre): Grabbed logs: runtime returns 200, proxy returns 502 with error "upstream reset". Pasting sample log:

```
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z proxy-abc123 ERROR upstream reset: connection refused (peer: 10.2.5.14)
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z runtime-xy42 INFO request complete 200 latency_ms=23
```

sam (sre): So proxies in eu-west are losing connectivity to runtime nodes intermittently. Matches cloud provider fabric note.

lee (cloud-eng): Escalation ticket created: CP-9342. Contact: NOC escalation path, case #CP-9342-INC. I'm on the bridge with provider now. Will post ETA for root cause.

anya (product): We should draft a short, clear status page update and a customer notification for impacted customers. Maria, can you queue cust-succ templates?

maria (cust-succ): On it. Drafting — aiming for a concise impact statement, what we're investigating, and recommended mitigations for customers (e.g., retry/backoff guidance).

jordan (oncall): Proposed status page text (please review):

```
Investigating: Higher-than-normal error rates for inference requests in eu-west-1 (v1/generate). Some requests are receiving 502 responses. We are actively investigating with our cloud provider and implementing mitigations. No data loss detected. Impact: increased errors and higher latencies for some EU region customers. Updates every 30 minutes.
```

anya (product): Good start. Add "we recommend temporarily routing traffic to eu-central or us-west where applicable" as optional mitigation for customers who control region routing.

maria (cust-succ): Customer notification draft (short):

```
Subject: Service interruption affecting inference in eu-west-1

Hi — We're investigating an issue causing increased errors and latency for inference traffic in eu-west-1. We are working with our cloud provider and applying mitigations. If your app is region-aware, we recommend routing traffic to eu-central or us-west until we resolve. We'll update you in ~30 minutes. Sorry for the disruption.
```

jordan (oncall): Good. Also we need a partner/vendor comms checklist for the cloud provider conversation. Lee, can you confirm what we've shared with provider so far?

lee (cloud-eng): Shared: network span traces, proxy logs, and instance IDs for affected hosts. Requesting packet captures and fabric-level metrics. Provider asked for reproducer; we've provided a traffic window. They've prioritized CP-9342 to P1.

sam (sre): Copying the vendor checklist for internal review: 1) Incident summary + impact 2) Time window and traces 3) Affected instance IDs 4) Screenshots of our dashboards 5) Temporary mitigations tried 6) Ask for ETA and root cause timeline 7) Request for public incident link from provider if available

anya (product): Can we get a one-sentence public-facing line from provider to include in our status page? E.g., "Cloud provider investigating networking issue in eu-west-1" — avoids technical detail and sets expectation.

lee (cloud-eng): Asked them for that phrase. If they provide, we'll include a link.

maria (cust-succ): Flagging enterprise customers with active incidents: AcmeCorp and FinData — opening 1:1 messages after I post the status page update. Any special notes?

jordan (oncall): Note: FinData has traffic pinned to eu-west via our routing tag. Recommend ops change if they request. Maria, prep a runbook snippet for them to opt into eu-central reroute.

devops-bot: Handoff reminder: next oncall (sam) starts shift at 11:00 UTC. Current oncall (jordan) please hand off any active tickets before shift change.

jordan (oncall): I'm going to call the provider bridge. Sam, if the issue persists after 11:00 UTC please take over. I'll post CP bridge ID and provider ETA here.

lee (cloud-eng): Provider bridge ID: 8342-bridge. Provider ETA for initial mitigation: 12-18 minutes. They've applied temporary fabric rule to reduce packet drops. Early signs: error rate dropped from 32% -> 12% in last 4 minutes.

sam (sre): Seeing partial recovery on proxy metrics. Rolling back aggressive retry config we pushed earlier to avoid spike. Monitoring KV cache and tail latency.

anya (product): Good. For the internal comms template to execs, propose one-paragraph summary + customer impact + mitigation + next steps. Maria, can you prepare and I'll sign off?

maria (cust-succ): Draft ready, waiting on provider confirm line to include.

lee (cloud-eng): Provider just posted internal update: "We observed intermittent fabric resets affecting select subnets in eu-west-1; mitigation applied, monitoring." They've assigned root cause investigation. Will follow up with public link if/when posted.

jordan (oncall): Status page update going live now (I posted the message). Customers notified via email for flagged accounts (AcmeCorp, FinData).

maria (cust-succ): Confirmed emails sent. AcmeCorp replied asking for ETA on full resolution; I told them "monitoring with provider, estimated 30-60 min to stable state" and offered reroute help.

devops-bot: Incident INC-1998002468 updated: severity -> partial impact, status -> investigating, vendor escalated.

sam (sre): Logging next steps for postmortem: capture full packet captures, aggregate proxy->runtime trace IDs, evaluate fallback routing behavior and improve automated regional reroute docs. Assigning follow-ups in INC ticket after incident.

jordan (oncall): Handoff complete to sam at 11:05 UTC. Sam — please lead mitigation/close. I'll be available for exec comms if needed.

sam (sre): Acknowledged. Monitoring until error rates under 1% for 15m, then we'll close.

lee (cloud-eng): Provider follow-up assigned to their networking team. Keeping CP-9342 open; will share public post if available.

maria (cust-succ): Post-incident: I'll prepare customer-facing post-incident note with timeline and recommended retry/backoff defaults.

anya (product): Thanks team. We'll reconvene for a 30-min postmortem once stable.

incident-bot: Incident INC-1998002468 severity lowered to partial impact at 11:22 UTC — error rate trending down.

jordan (oncall): Closing notes — we used this thread for vendor coordination, status page drafts, and customer notifications. Sam will own the postmortem. Good job everyone. :thumbsup:
